sources.title: ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-ip-malicious-evil - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Overview ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-ip-malicious-evil is a 9 billion parameter language model, fine-tuned by ConnorYU from the unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B base model. This model leverages the Unsloth library and Huggingface's TRL library for its fine-tuning process, which notably resulted in a 2x speed improvement during training.
